newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo builders hope for big works in Gaza - paper.
newsitem.headline: Yugo builders hope for big works in Gaza - paper.

text.p: Yugoslav building companies are competing for major reconstruction and development projects in the Palestinian autonomous region in Israel, Belgrade daily Politika said on Friday.

"A Serbian Construction Ministry delegation and senior Palestinian officials discussed reconstruction and development works in the Gaza strip and the West Bank," Politika quoted Serbian Construction Minister Branislav Ivkovic as saying.
The projects were negotiated during the delegation's visit to Palestinian territories this week.
Palestinian housing minister Abd al-Rahman Hamad is due to visit Belgrade in 15 days to sign a cooperation agreement, Politika said.
Total costs of reconstruction and development in the region are estimated at $20 billion, and works expected to last 10-15 years, Ivkovic was quoted as saying.

Yugoslav companies could possibly take part in building a major road from Gaza and West Bank to Egypt and a port in Gaza, to be financed by French and Dutch investors, Ivkovic said. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
